title: Make guidance resume idempotent and reject stale sequences
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host and loads the verify_repair durable graph under a story controller with an in-memory run store. He starts a run that yields guidance, answers once with an idempotency key (run completes), replays the same key (same committed sequence), then tries a stale sequence under another key and sees a safe sequence refusal — so drivers can retry without double-applying advice. Tracks R-IOC-IDEMPOTENT[^insp-ioc-06].
implementation: `DurableGraphGenerator.resume` stores results under `idempotency_key` and compares `expected_sequence` to the run record. CLI durable verbs `start` / `answer` drive the same session through `CliInstrumentor`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph.recipe verify_repair with durable session; steps start/answer with per-step expects; complete asserts terminal sequence refusal.
